title: Q-SPEC-00-T03: a ledger row behind every RUNNING label (US-00-T03)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** specification audit 2026-11-26 (specs/ against the code)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/spec_truth.py --running
**Status:** open

US-00-T03 is PLANNED: no check reads a production ledger row for a status line labelled RUNNING in `specs/`. Add `--running` to `scripts/spec_truth.py`: a RUNNING line must name, in backticks, a ledger that exists (`ops/deploys.jsonl` or another append-only ledger) and that ledger must hold a row from the last 7 days for the thing the line names; a line that names none is a finding, held in the same shrink-only baseline if it fails on the day the check lands. Unit test in `tests/foundation/test_spec_truth.py`. Then set the US-00-T03 row of `specs/US-SPEC-00-conformance.md` to BUILT with the file and test.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 scripts/spec_truth.py --running`
**Prediction:** running_labels_without_a_ledger_row <= 0 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** an outside audit of the numbers a RUNNING system reports; changing what RUNNING means.
